Receipt

The Receipt view displays the details of a receipt transaction that has been recorded in the system.

A receipt represents money received from customers, suppliers, or other parties. This view shows all the important details including the payer, amount, date, and line items.

From this view, you can perform several actions:

• Print - Generate a PDF version of the receipt for printing or saving

• Email - Send the receipt directly to the payer via email

• Edit - Make changes to the receipt details

• Copy to - Create a new transaction based on this receipt

To learn about creating and editing receipts, see: Receipt — Edit
